meta_data.base_class: Create meal plans rich in specific <nutrients> - refers to various essential nutritional components for the human body.

tool_template.name: <class>RichMealPlanner_generateList
tool_template.description: Create a list of meals that are high in <class>.

meal_type.description: Type of meal to focus on, e.g., breakfast, lunch, dinner.

include_vegetarian_options.description: Whether to include vegetarian meal options.

cuisine_preference.description: Preferred cuisine type, e.g., Italian, Asian.

dietary_restrictions.description: List of dietary restrictions to consider, such as 'gluten-free', 'nut-free'.

preparation_time.description: Maximum preparation time allowed for each meal in minutes.

allergen_information.description: Whether to include allergen information for each <class>-rich meal.

meal_variability.description: Whether to ensure variability in the types of <class>-rich meals suggested.

serving_size.description: Recommended serving size for each meal in grams.
